text:
oncall-bot: PAGING: ap-northeast3 Zone C egress degradation - elevated error rates observed for generation endpoints. Paging SRE on-call.

maria.g: seeing 502/504 from edge proxies to our egress NATs starting ~10:20 UTC, spike in dropped flows. Retrying shows partial success.

ajay.s: confirm - metrics: egress_packets_dropped +1200/s, connection_reset +900/s. Affected: text-generation, streaming responses. Embeddings appear OK.

ira: is this isolated to zone C or all of ap-northeast3?

maria.g: looks concentrated on zone C POPs: edge-a, edge-b. zone A/B fine.

sre_lead: initial hypothesis: upstream transit peer in that AZ is flapping / NAT pool exhausted. Routing team see anything? @ajay.s can you check BGP session states w/ peer X?

ajay.s: running quick check, bgp sessions show flaps on peer-x-azc, ifdown/ifup every ~30s. Ticketing provider.

maria.g: mitigation plan proposal: divert outbound egress for affected zone to west-us1 via fallback mesh for customer traffic; enable ephemeral NAT mapping on fallback; limit burst to 60rps per customer while we stabilize.

support_ops: customer impact: several customers reporting increased 5xxs and long streaming stalls. CS is queued for comms if we need status page.

ira: agree on diversion. Steps?

sre_lead: timeline: 1) announce incident on status page (minor/partial outage, ap-northeast3 zone C) 2) reroute policy push (5m) 3) enable NAT fallback + token throttles (10m) 4) monitor error rate and latency (ongoing) 5) rollback when upstream stable.

maria.g: pushing a canary reroute now to 10% of egress from zone C to west-us1 to validate path. Command used (kube):

```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart configmap/egress-routing && kubectl apply -f egress-reroute-canary-apn3-zonec.yaml
```

canary in, initial 10% shows 200s for redirected flows but success rate up from 63% -> 84%.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-APN3-EGRESS-2170012345. Assigned to maria.g, severity: P2. Runbook: egress-fallback-v2.

ajay.s: provider says they're seeing a NAT translation pool depletion on their side in az-c, they are scaling. ETA unclear (~30m-1h).

maria.g: recommend posting status page: short note + guidance for customers; internal comm template also needed for AE/CS. Draft below. Please review quickly.

statusbot: suggested status page component: "ap-northeast3 (Zone C) - egress connectivity degraded - partial impact to generation APIs".

maria.g: DRAFT status page update (please copy/paste):

"We are currently investigating elevated error rates impacting outbound egress from ap-northeast3 Zone C which is causing increased 5xx responses for text generation endpoints. We have implemented a fallback routing change to divert affected traffic to an alternate region to restore service, and are working with our transit provider to remediate the upstream NAT exhaustion. Impact: partial – a subset of requests may experience increased latency or errors. ETA for full remediation: TBD. We will post updates every 15 minutes."

ira: tweak: add mitigations and a short customer-facing action: "If you see persistent failures, retry with exponential backoff; token may be throttled briefly."

support_ops: Customer comm draft for CS (short):

"Hey — we're investigating elevated errors for the ap-northeast3 (Zone C) region affecting text-generation. We've implemented a temporary reroute to restore service and are working with our provider. We recommend retrying requests for a short period; no action required from your side. We'll send follow-ups as we learn more. — Redwood Inference Status Team"

sre_lead: internal comm to execs (brief):

"Summary: ap-northeast3 Zone C egress experiencing upstream NAT exhaustion causing increased 5xxs on generation services. Mitigation: traffic being diverted to west-us1; provider is scaling NAT capacity. Customer impact: partial, ongoing. Next update in 15 minutes."

maria.g: pushing full reroute now (bump to 100% for zone C). Applying config: `egress-reroute-apn3-zonec-full.yaml`

ajay.s: full reroute applied. Observability: error rate down from 38% -> 6% within 90s, tail latency up ~200ms on rerouted flows.

oncall-bot: Pager status: acknowledged by maria.g. Handoff scheduled if > 2 hours.

ira: we should add a customer-facing FAQ snippet: what happened, what we changed, what to expect. Draft below.

FAQ draft: "Why did I see errors? Upstream provider in ap-northeast3 Zone C experienced NAT pool exhaustion causing some outbound connections to fail. What did Redwood do? We diverted affected traffic to a healthy region and applied temporary throttles to protect stability. Will my data be routed outside region? Some requests may be routed to another region while we remediate; we are not persisting customer data in the fallback route beyond normal request processing. Next steps: provider scaling, then we will revert when stable and inform you."

support_ops: CS team ready to paste the short draft into Intercom + add note to high-touch customers.

maria.g: monitoring for provider heal. Provider message: "scaling NAT pool in progress, gradual stabilization expected in 20-40 minutes".

ajay.s: continuing to monitor BGP flaps; sessions stable since reroute.

sre_lead: OK, we keep incident open. cadence: updates every 15 minutes. If error rate <1% for 10m post-revert, we'll close.

ira: log for postmortem: collect: packet drops, egress proxy logs, bgp syslogs, provider comms, reroute timing, status page history, customer comms. Assign to maria.g for exec timeline, ajay.s for network timeline.

maria.g: noted. starting checklist:
- archive config snapshots (done)
- capture pcap sample from edge-a (requesting)
- escalate to provider ops (in progress)

oncall-bot: Next scheduled update at 2170012445 (100s).

support_ops: queueing CS follow-up for high-impact accounts.

maria.g: quick numbers update: after full reroute, generation success rate 95%, tail latency 350-600ms for rerouted flows. We'll keep throttles in place for 30m and reassess.

ira: thanks team. Posting status page now. Use support_ops draft for CS. Keep thread updated with provider ETA changes.

statusbot: Status update posted: "ap-northeast3 (Zone C) egress degraded — fallback routing applied, partial impact. Next update in 15 minutes."

maria.g: provider says NAT scaling complete, sessions stabilized at 2170012560. Starting canary revert to zone-local egress (10%).

ajay.s: canary revert shows stable egress, error rate remains <2% during canary. Rolling revert to 100% now.

maria.g: revert complete, monitoring. Success metrics: 99.7% success for generation post-revert, latency normalized. Removing throttles.

sre_lead: preparing incident close when we confirm 10m stable. Postmortem owner: maria.g. Network timeline owner: ajay.s. Customer comm follow-up to include apology + timeline.

support_ops: sending final customer note to impacted accounts now.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-APN3-EGRESS-2170012345 status: RESOLVED (monitoring). Close reason: upstream NAT scaled; routing reverted.

maria.g: filing postmortem and timeline. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
